build_necessity: Reported Debug/ASan/UBSan is source environment; no assertion/debug variable/sanitizer diagnostic is needed to observe this specific wrong-result/error pattern. Release result is explicitly an alternate-build observation; a negative cannot rule out the original instrumented build.

oracle.reported_pattern: CREATE TABLE and CREATE VIEW succeed; SELECT FROM view fails 1356 while equivalent direct SELECT succeeds. Permissions/object existence must be established; 1356 alone is insufficient.
oracle.normal: Both computations agree, or documented valid DDL/view works with required controls.
oracle.classification_rule: reproduced only when exact report pattern and controls hold; otherwise not_reproduced only after all required statements complete, unexpected error -> execution_failed, different anomaly -> other_anomaly.

expected_errors.purpose: reported view-select error; direct SELECT control must succeed
